notes:
HOST: a real UCIe->AXI-lite bridge exists on main: hfd_host_native (rtl/hbm_accel/io_native_20261014) = ot_pdie_ucie + hfd_lk_ep (CRC/replay endpoint) + ot_hbm_host_landing256 (2 x 256x256 SRAM) + ot_hbm_host_packet (packet engine, AXI-lite master s_*), joined to ot_hbm_host_static_ingress in hfd_host_static_native_qdq_program. It is lifted leaf-by-leaf: host_N (the granted ot_pdie_ucie macro) + host_cp_ep_face/host_cp_ep (hfd_lk_ep is a wires-only wrapper over inout die buses, lifted to its two leaves) + host_cp_landing + host_cp_packet in the host_cp window + host_cp_ingress. hfd_host_native's glue (6-bit tx credit counter, zero pads, pad_fault, fault concat) has no die home -> gaps G-HOST-TXCREDIT / G-HOST-PAD / G-STATUS; session id has no producer (G-HOST-SESSION); the loader service face of the packet engine (h_*/h_dma_*/m_*/irq/fault) belonged to the retired dynamic loader/CP (G-HOST-LOADERFACE).
Clock family: hfd_host_native and the ingress README both require ONE synchronous family from PHY digital side to programme targets (no CDC exists); the granted host_cp_ingress slot is clock_domain stream, so every host instance incl. host_N.clk is put on stream. If the coordinator wants host_N on link, a real CDC between endpoint and ingress is missing (doubt).
AXI-lite valid/ready between host_cp_packet and host_cp_ingress is treated as part of the off-die host boundary (README: "host elasticity ends at configuration writes"); nothing after the ingress uses ready/credit.
LOADER: only target 48 (QDQ NW, hb_quant_NW) matches the ingress frame exactly and is bound (9 edges, basis hfd_host_static_native_qdq_program + v15 required_owner "host/CP loader (NW target 48)"). VM calendars, svc groups, SFU, IDX, COLL, ARGMAX, SU need target ids / collars / adapters (G-HOST-LOADER-*). ot_vms_calendar_host_static was examined and rejected (depends on retired CP doorbell/passthrough, shadows F20-F2c). Readiness aggregate absent (G-HOST-READY).
QUANT: hb_quant_NW (ot_hgi_qdq_host_static RL7 WC4 COMPACT1) KEPT; split leaves granted but no parent composition on main (G-QUANT-SPLIT). v15 VM edges quant_vm_rq/rr/wq stand.
DMA: hb_dbk_<q> master changed to grants-v7 ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks (STK SW0 SE1 NW2 NE3, same as grant params), v15 rq/rr edges stand; command + WB-band ports gap (G-DMA).
HC: no static LG-client HC master on main (G-HC); no hc_* / hc_eng instances emitted.
VM STATUS: vm_status4 fully driven by v15 status edges (restated); vmstat and the calendars' status outputs have no consumer. | cp2 2026-10-15: host face/status gaps G-HOST-TXCREDIT/PAD/LOADERFACE/READY/LOADER-OTHERS/STATUS closed by cp2.json (G-HOST-SESSION re-pointed there)
